mechanism: The skip test is inverted: files with an mtime at or after the previous run are skipped and only untouched files are yielded. The incremental mirror therefore copies exactly the complement of the changed set and never copies an edited file -- and on a first run, where last_sync defaults to 0.0, it copies nothing at all. Edited assets silently stop reaching the mirror while the job still logs a file count and succeeds.
accepted_finding_forms: the comparison is backwards -- `>=` skips the files modified since the last sync, which are the ones that need copying
changed_since yields unchanged files and filters out changed ones; the operator should be <=
